focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期规则细化，中国出口钢铁铝材合规成本上升
focus.summary: 本周，欧盟委员会发布碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期实施细则补充文件，明确2026年10月起进口商需提交产品嵌入式排放量报告，且2027年起需购买CBAM证书。该机制覆盖钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥等产品，中国作为主要出口国受影响显著。本周多家中国钢铁企业收到欧盟进口商要求提供碳排放数据，合规成本预计增加15%-20%。同时，美国对华301关税复审听证会结束，预计8月公布结果，可能维持或提高部分商品关税。全球贸易碎片化趋势加剧，企业需加速供应链碳核算与合规能力建设。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会官网 · 本周
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Rules Tightened, Compliance Costs for Chinese Steel and Aluminum Exports Rise
focus.summary_en: This week, the European Commission issued supplementary details for the transitional implementation of the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), requiring importers to submit product embedded emission reports from October 2026 and purchase CBAM certificates from 2027. The mechanism covers steel, aluminum, cement, and fertilizers, significantly impacting China as a major exporter. Multiple Chinese steel firms received requests from EU importers for carbon emission data this week, with compliance costs expected to increase by 15%-20%. Meanwhile, the U.S. Section 301 tariff review hearing concluded, with results expected in August, potentially maintaining or raising tariffs on some goods. The trend of global trade fragmentation is intensifying, urging companies to accelerate supply chain carbon accounting and compliance.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission official website · this week

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境特许经营协议中“不竞争条款”因地域过广被认定无效
case.summary: 本周，新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）就一起中国企业与东南亚被特许人之间的特许经营纠纷作出裁决，认定特许经营协议中约定的“在整个东南亚地区禁止竞争”的条款因地域范围过广、超出合理保护商业利益所需，构成不合理限制竞争，违反新加坡竞争法，故该条款无效。仲裁庭强调，不竞争条款的地域范围应与特许人的实质性投资和商业秘密保护需求相称。本案启示：出海企业在设计特许经营或独家分销协议时，应结合具体市场、品牌知名度及投资规模，合理限定不竞争的地域和期限，避免因条款过于宽泛而被认定为无效。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心 · 2026年6月裁决
case.title_en: SIAC Rules Non-Compete Clause in Cross-Border Franchise Agreement Invalid Due to Excessive Geographic Scope
case.summary_en: This week, the Singapore International Arbitration Center (SIAC) ruled in a franchise dispute between a Chinese company and a Southeast Asian franchisee, holding that a non-compete clause covering the entire Southeast Asia region was invalid for being excessively broad and beyond what is reasonably necessary to protect legitimate business interests, violating Singapore's competition law. The tribunal emphasized that the geographic scope of non-compete clauses must be proportionate to the franchisor's substantial investments and trade secret protection needs. Key takeaway: When designing franchise or exclusive distribution agreements, companies going overseas should tailor non-compete geographic and duration limits based on specific markets, brand recognition, and investment scale to avoid being deemed invalid due to overbreadth.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Center · June 2026 ruling

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”机制落地，首批涵盖金融、医疗等8个行业
policy.summary: 本周，广东省互联网信息办公室联合香港、澳门相关部门正式发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规范（试行）》，建立数据出境“白名单”机制。首批白名单涵盖金融、医疗、交通、电子商务等8个行业，列入白名单的企业在向港澳传输必要业务数据时，无需单独进行数据出境安全评估，仅需履行备案义务。此举预计将大幅降低大湾区企业跨境数据合规成本，促进区域数字贸易与金融科技合作。但企业需注意，白名单仅适用于“必要业务数据”，个人敏感信息及重要数据仍须遵守更高标准。建议企业尽快对照白名单条件进行自查，争取首批备案。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 本周
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow 'Whitelist' Mechanism Launched, Initially Covering 8 Sectors Including Finance and Healthcare
policy.summary_en: This week, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province, together with relevant authorities in Hong Kong and Macao, officially released the 'Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow Security Management Regulations (Trial)', establishing a data exit 'whitelist' mechanism. The first batch covers 8 sectors including finance, healthcare, transportation, and e-commerce. Enterprises on the whitelist can transfer necessary business data to Hong Kong and Macao without separate data exit security assessments, only needing to fulfill filing obligations. This is expected to significantly reduce cross-border data compliance costs for enterprises in the Greater Bay Area and promote regional digital trade and fintech cooperation. However, companies should note that the whitelist only applies to 'necessary business data'; personal sensitive information and important data still require higher standards. It is recommended that companies promptly self-check against whitelist conditions and strive for early filing.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应建立“碳合规+数据合规”双轨机制，动态应对欧美监管分化
analysis.summary: 本周，欧盟CBAM细则与美国301关税听证会形成鲜明对比：欧盟以碳边境调节推动绿色贸易规则，美国则延续单边关税工具。秦林蒿律师研判认为，出海企业需建立“双轨合规机制”：一是碳合规，立即启动产品碳足迹核算，优先在钢铁、铝材、化工等高碳行业部署第三方认证，并关注欧盟CBAM证书交易市场动态；二是数据合规，利用粤港澳大湾区数据跨境白名单试点，优化内部数据分类与跨境传输架构，同时密切跟踪美国《数据隐私和保护法案》立法进程。下周关注：欧盟《外国补贴条例》首批调查结果可能公布，涉及中国光伏、风电企业；建议相关企业提前准备抗辩材料。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 本周研判
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: Outbound Enterprises Should Establish a 'Carbon Compliance + Data Compliance' Dual-Track Mechanism to Dynamically Respond to EU-US Regulatory Divergence
analysis.summary_en: This week, the EU's CBAM details and the US Section 301 tariff hearing presented a stark contrast: the EU promotes green trade rules through carbon border adjustments, while the US continues unilateral tariff tools. Attorney Qin Linhao assesses that outbound enterprises need to establish a 'dual-track compliance mechanism': first, carbon compliance—immediately start product carbon footprint accounting, prioritize third-party certification in high-carbon sectors such as steel, aluminum, and chemicals, and monitor the CBAM certificate trading market; second, data compliance—leverage the Greater Bay Area cross-border data whitelist pilot to optimize internal data classification and cross-border transfer structures, while closely tracking the US Data Privacy and Protection Act legislative process. Next week's focus: The first batch of investigation results under the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation may be released, involving Chinese photovoltaic and wind power companies; relevant enterprises are advised to prepare defense materials in advance.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · weekly view
